description: Get HUD Fair Market Rents (FMR) for a county, metro area, or entire state. Shows monthly rent by bedroom count (efficiency through 4-bedroom). FMR determines Section 8 voucher amounts.

entity_id.description: County FIPS or CBSA code for specific area FMR (get from hud_list_counties)

state.description: State for state-wide FMR data: name, two-letter code or FIPS code (e.g. 'California', 'CA', '06')

year.description: Fiscal year (e.g. 2024). Defaults to current year.

name: hud_fair_market_rents
